_readme: Variant-id collisions that exist on master and have NOT been migrated yet.
Read by apps/web/tools/check-variant-registry.cjs. This list only ratchets
DOWN: a collision that is not listed here fails the build, and a listed
collision that no longer occurs ALSO fails until its entry is deleted.
Adding an entry is a migration decision, not a way to make CI green —
every entry needs a reason that says what it would take to remove it.
EMPTY IS THE TARGET STATE. It has been empty since 2026-09-11, when the
only entry ('retail-loyalty-qr') was fixed rather than carried: the LOSING
registration was renamed, so the id keeps resolving to the exact renderer
it already resolved to and no saved TemplateZone changed. See
V2_ID_OVERRIDES in variants-register.ts. Renaming the WINNER would have
